messages:
Maya (Marketing Lead): Quick sync — we have the webinar + launch posts scheduled for May 12. Need final landing copy variants for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages + a simple inbound routing plan that sends leads to the right page and webinar funnel. Can we draft a lightweight playbook here? :rocket:
Priya (Content): Happy to draft. For clarity: do we want 3 distinct hero CTAs (Try Hosted, Book Dedicated, Request Private demo) or a single hero with segmented secondary CTAs?
Noor (Design): Prefer distinct hero treatments — visuals help differentiate trust/scale/privacy. I can mock small variants by EOD Thu.
Jorge (Growth): Distinct CTAs are better for tracking conversion signals. We'll need UTM patterns and a routing rule so sales gets the right lead type.
Alex (Product): Also confirm the qualifying questions on the registration form so we can automatically classify Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Minimal: company size, compliance need, expected RPS.
Maya (Marketing Lead): Agreed. Priya — can you produce short hero copy lines we can A/B? Keep them <10 words. Also add 2 launch-post captions for LI/X and 1 long-form benchmark thread for the blog.
Priya (Content): Drafting 3 hero lines now:
- Hosted API: "Launch fast with hosted LLM inference."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput. Dedicated GPUs."
- Private: "Private deployments for regulated data."
Draft social captions:
LI/X short post 1: "Launching our webinar on real-world LLM economics — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. RSVP: <link> #inference #mlops"
LI/X short post 2: "How we optimize latency & cost for production LLMs — join our demo on May 12. Seats limited. <link>"
Benchmark thread header (blog): "Latency, cost, and quality: benchmarking three deployment modes across real workloads."
Noor (Design): Nice. I'll pair each hero with a small icon & color: green for Hosted (ease), blue for Dedicated (SLA), purple for Private (security).
Jorge (Growth): Routing & UTMs — propose this pattern so analytics lines up: utm_source=launchpost&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=may12_webinar&utm_term=mode_hosted (or mode_dedicated/mode_private)
Jorge (Growth): And redirect links on social should point to landing?mode=hosted (etc.) so frontend can show mode-specific banner and preselect the CTA.
Sam (Ops): For inbound lead routing, we can auto-tag and forward leads to the right queue based on form answers + URL param. Example rule we can implement in HubSpot: if url_param.mode == "private" OR compliance_need == "yes" -> assign to Enterprise/Private queue.
Sam (Ops): Quick pseudo-rule: ```json
{
  "if": [
    {"param.mode": "private"},
    {"form.compliance_need": "yes"},
    {"company.size": ">=1000"}
  ],
  "then": {"assign": "enterprise-private@example.com", "tag": "private"}
}
```
Priya (Content): For the webinar signup form copy (short):
- Headline: "Which inference mode fits your product?"
- Subhead: "Live benchmarks and deployment patterns — May 12"
- Fields: Name, Email, Company, Company size (dropdown), Primary use case (free text), Compliance requirements (yes/no)
Alex (Product): Add a hidden field 'landing_mode' populated from url param so we can attribute conversion by mode.
Noor (Design): I need the final hero copy and button texts to mock in Figma — propose button text: Hosted: "Try Hosted API", Dedicated: "Discuss Dedicated", Private: "Request Private Demo"
Maya (Marketing Lead): Good. Priya please create two 280-char social variants (one technical, one outcome-focused) and attach CTAs with the UTM pattern Jorge suggested. Also prepare a short benchmark blurb (3 bullet takeaways) for the blog landing.
Priya (Content): Will do. Draft takeaways: 1) Prefix/KV caching reduces token cost by 35% on bursty workloads. 2) Dedicated pools hit 99.9% throughput for high-concurrency inference. 3) Private deployments reduce lateral data exposure risk with integrated KMS.
Jorge (Growth): One more: ensure the email confirmation flow shows the recommended product page based on landing_mode. e.g., "Thanks — see Hosted docs" link for mode=hosted.
Sam (Ops): We'll add webhooks from HubSpot that include tags and landing_mode so SRE can surface telemetry for leads that convert from the webinar.
calendar-bot: Event scheduled: "Webinar — LLM inference launch" May 12 11:00-12:00 UTC (organizer: maya@redwood.ai)
Maya (Marketing Lead): Timeline: copy freeze Thu EOD, design Figma by Fri noon, QA of routing + UTMs Mon, deploy posts Tue morning, webinar May 12. If anyone sees dependency risks call them out now. :eyes:
Alex (Product): Risk: Dedicated pricing details still TBC. Recommend we route Dedicated leads to a 'pricing-interest' tag and use templated follow-up until pricing final.
Priya (Content): Noted — we'll use "Discuss Dedicated" CTA not a price link.
Noor (Design): I'll share 3 quick Figma frames in #design-review once copy is frozen.
Jorge (Growth): I'll assemble the UTM + redirect matrix and post it here tomorrow.
Maya (Marketing Lead): Awesome — thanks team. Priya, ping when copy is ready and I'll prep the email + blog publish schedule. :thumbsup:
